mechanism_narrative: Low unemployment rates signal a strong labor market, which positively impacts consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 returns are negative when UNRATE is below 5%.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in housing starts indicates strong demand in the housing market, which spills over into the broader economy, leading to positive S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: Housing starts increase but S&P 500 returns remain negative.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in retail sales and housing starts indicates strong aggregate demand, positively influencing S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: Both RSAFS and HOUST grow, but S&P 500 returns are negative.

mechanism_narrative: Low federal funds rates stimulate borrowing and investment, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS below 4% but S&P 500 returns are negative.

mechanism_narrative: Increasing industrial production indicates economic growth, leading to positive S&P 500 returns in 5 days.
failure_condition: INDPRO growth but negative S&P 500 returns.

mechanism_narrative: Strong payroll growth signals economic expansion, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: PAYEMS growth exceeds 0.2% MoM but S&P 500 returns are negative.

mechanism_narrative: High GDP growth coupled with low unemployment indicates strong economic fundamentals, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: GDPC1 growth and UNRATE low but S&P 500 returns negative.

mechanism_narrative: Retail sales growth in late-cycle expansion indicates sustained consumer demand, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: RSAFS growth but negative S&P 500 returns.
